items.text: Pittsburgh ruled out CB Brandin Echols (hamstring) and WR Ben Skowronek (calf); DT Sebastian Joseph-Day (triceps) went to IR Thursday. CB Jalen Ramsey (wrist) went from no practice Wednesday to limited Thursday; T.J. Watt limited Thursday, Alex Highsmith and RB Rico Dowdle limited both days. Aaron Rodgers is not on the report.

New Orleans G Cesar Ruiz (knee) did not practice Wednesday and is unlikely to play; Alvin Kamara (back) was limited. Tyler Shough practiced fully while playing through broken bones in his non-throwing hand. WR Jordyn Tyson and RB Travis Etienne Jr. are on IR. Game is in Paris (9:30am ET).
Pittsburgh WRs Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson are on IR.
